data: Which of the following class labels were used in the uncertainty estimation study?

The question asks which class labels were used in the uncertainty estimation study. From the caption, we know that the figure is about the effect of class labels on uncertainty estimates. The three subfigures (a), (b), and (c) show different datasets: Epistemic PHEME, Epistemic Twitter 15, and Epistemic Twitter 16. Each subfigure contains box plots for four categories: True, False, Non-Rumour, and Unverified. These categories represent the class labels used in the study. Therefore, the class labels used in the uncertainty estimation study are True, False, Non-Rumour, and Unverified.
